shop.name: NiftyNestGifts
shop.positioning: General gift store (not pet-focused): occasions, hobbies, professions, family roles, locations; pets are one category among many.

pricing.strategy: Price competitively: at or slightly below competitor benchmarks (research/competitors.json). Margins don't need to be high.

timing.line: Made to order: ships in 2-7 business days (Printify production), then 2-5 business days US delivery. Free US shipping.

sources.claim: Printify standard US shipping 2-5 business days

must_include: Made to order: ships in 2-7 business days
description.note: No AI wording in descriptions; the Etsy AI flag is set separately in listing settings.

production_partner.name: Printify
production_partner.description: Print-on-demand partner prints and ships our original designs

title.example: Sleigh All Day Coffee Mug, Boho Christmas Gift, Eucalyptus Holiday Cup 11oz

photos.main_photo: styled lifestyle scene with background (product in use, liquid visible, seasonal props) - NEVER a plain white mockup as photo 1; white mockups go later in the gallery

design.print_ready: Create at the provider print-area size (11oz mug: 2700x1120, white background)

consistency.rule: Every lifestyle photo/video is generated FROM the real Printify mockup as reference/first frame. Keep the exact product: plain glossy white 11oz ceramic mug, C-handle, identical design, text and colors. Never generic, speckled, colored or different mugs.
consistency.qa: xAI vision compares each generated asset to the mockup (same shape, handle, design, text spelled identically); mismatches are rejected before use.

rules: Show the product in use (liquid in mugs, steam ok)
Seasonal props that match the design
No visible brand names or logos on props

recipe: Animate from a still that already shows the FINAL scene (e.g. liquid already in the mug)
Locked-off camera - no pans, zooms or orbits
Only subtle motion: steam, twinkle lights, light flicker
Big camera moves cause morphing (handle vanished, marshmallows appeared) - never use them

branding.banner: Etsy shop banner 3360x840 with all text in the center band (safe on mobile crop)

etsy_post_publish_checklist: Shipping profile: Free US Shipping - Printify
How it's made > What tools are used: ONLY 'An AI generator' checked (Etsy AI disclosure; production partner covers Printify printing)
Photo 1 = styled lifestyle scene, 5+ photos visible on Etsy (upload QA'd lifestyle photos; Printify syncs only selected mockups)
Etsy Offsite Ads ON (shop setting; Printify API cannot set it)

lessons.lesson: Shop is a general gift store, not dog-focused.
Always free US shipping, baked into price; keep 30% margin floor.
Etsy flagged repeated title words ('christmas', 'mug'): never repeat words; product word once with synonyms.
Remove AI wording from descriptions; AI disclosure is a listing setting only.
Video with big camera moves morphed the product (handle vanished, marshmallows appeared): use locked-off camera, subtle motion only, start from final-scene still.
Product consistency across ALL images/videos: generate from the real Printify mockup; exact plain glossy white 11oz mug, C-handle, identical design; QA-reject mismatches.
Main (first) listing photo must be a styled lifestyle scene, never a plain white mockup.
Listings need 5-10 photos; Etsy auto-renew on.
Enable Printify free Standard shipping ($7.29) and Etsy Offsite Ads (12%) on every release; price so worst-case margin (incl. ads) stays >= 30% (mug $29.99).
Every lifestyle photo/video must start from the real Printify mockup; automated vision QA rejects mismatched mugs.
Price competitively at/slightly below benchmarks; margins don't need to be high; floor = $5-6 worst-case profit (incl. 12% offsite ads). Sleigh All Day stays $25.99.
Enable personalization on every release (~20% higher price for personalized); proofs need Dom approval before production.
Printify delayed orders auto-send to production; flag held orders in the digest.

Standard release checks = Dom's Printify store settings (auto-send delayed orders, 1-hour auto submission incl. personalized, details-to-publish: mockups and shipping profile OFF). Verify per-product settings before publish + daily audit; monthly confirm store settings.
Conflict: personalized orders auto-submit after 1 hour, so worker proofs may arrive after production starts - proofs are best-effort unless Dom changes that setting.
Personalized orders set to Manual in Printify so proofs are approved before production (resolves the auto-submit conflict).
Deleted 'Cozy Electric Sparks' electrician mug draft: did not meet requirements (1 photo, no lifestyle main photo, personalization off). Only release ideas that pass the full playbook.

Standard personalization buyer instructions: "Please add only the text you want printed on your product. Reach out to us directly for any additional requests." (Printify format captured; applied to every release).
Mandatory pre-publish review gate: vision review of every photo + full listing-details review; any failure blocks publish and goes to Dom with reasons.

Teacher Elves published with only 1 photo synced: the API cannot select mockups (PUT images is ignored) and Printify keeps only the default mockup selected; store 'details to publish: mockups' is OFF. Fix: select all mockups in the Printify editor (or turn store mockups ON) before publish; gate blocks <5 selected; post-publish sync check flags it.

Mountain Man (worker draft) was NOT published: it waited for approval because guardrails failed (4 photos, 68-char title, no lifestyle main photo). Its Printify photo 1 is a plain white mockup, so photo 1 must be a QA'd lifestyle upload.
Etsy 'How it's made > What tools are used' must have ONLY 'An AI generator' checked; not readable via API, so daily digest reminds.

personalization.api: Captured from Printify editor 2026-10-11 (Sleigh All Day): sales_channel_properties.personalisation = {instructions, buyer_response_limit: 50}. Worker sets it on every new product; audit flags any mismatch.
personalization.pricing: personalized option ~20% higher, still >= $5.50 worst-case profit
pipeline: Personalized orders are detected (on-hold) by the hourly worker
Custom design generated from the buyer request + playbook rules; consistency QA vs the original mockup
Proof emailed to Dom (queued until email provider) + shown in Live Ops approvals
On approval: new Printify order with the custom design, original on-hold order cancelled
personalization.buyer_instructions: Please add only the text you want printed on your product. Reach out to us directly for any additional requests.

printify_format.instructions: Please add only the text you want printed on your product. Reach out to us directly for any additional requests.

orders.delayed_orders: Dom set Printify to auto-send delayed orders to production; the worker flags any held/on-hold orders in the daily digest.

store_settings_monthly_confirm.personalized_orders: MANUAL (so the worker proof step can run before production)

publishing.variant_visibility: in-stock available + out-of-stock shown as sold out

store_settings_monthly_confirm.note: Store-level Printify settings are not readable via API - confirmed monthly by Dom (digest checklist).

per_product.personalization_instructions: Please add only the text you want printed on your product. Reach out to us directly for any additional requests.

release_checks.audit: Worker verifies readable per-product settings before every publish and in a daily audit of all products; mismatches are flagged in the digest (free_shipping auto-fixed).

pre_publish_review.photo_review: xAI vision review of EVERY photo vs the exact Printify front mockup: main photo = styled lifestyle scene with background; same product/print/colors; text legible and spelled right; exactly one mug, no artifacts or brand marks; design not split/duplicated
details_review: title rules (70-140 chars, Title Case, no repeated words, keyword front-loaded)
personalization on with Dom exact text
pre_publish_review.on_fail: block publish; reasons to approval queue (state "blocked by review gate"), Live Ops panel and daily digest
pre_publish_review.post_publish: verify photos that actually synced (Printify selected images >= 5); flag in audit/digest if fewer

memory.deleted_on_request: Products Dom asks to delete are removed from Printify/Etsy/queues and recorded in worker state + lessons so the worker never re-creates them (e.g. Cozy Electric Sparks).
